definition: τύπος, -ου, ὁ (τύπτω), [in LXX: Exo.25:39 (40) (תַּבְנִית), Amo.5:26, 3Ma.3:30, 4Ma.6:19 * ;] __1. the mark of a blow: τῶν ἥλων, Jhn.20:25.  __2. An impression, impress, the stamp made by a die; hence, a figure, image: Act.7:43 (LXX).  __3. form (Plat.): Rom.6:17; the sense or substance of a letter (3Mac, l.with), Act.23:25.  __4. an example, pattern: Act.7:44, Heb.8:6" (LXX) ; in ethical sense, Php.3:17, 1Th.1:7, 2Th.3:9, 1Ti.4:12, Tit.2:7, 1Pe.5:3; in doctrinal sense, type (see ICC, in l), Rom.5:14.†  τυπικῶς, adv.  (τύπος), __(a) typically (Greg. Naz.)  __(b) by way of example: 1Co.10:11.† SYN.: see: ὑποτύπωσις  (AS)
